title: Last Christmas
about: A struggling London actress working as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop meets someone who changes everything.
cue: Serve the sweets when Kate clocks on at the Christmas shop.
faces: STAY AS LONG AS YOU LIKE
I've hurt everyone around me. Tonight I cook for my family and stay for dessert.
Kate, Floor Staff. Ten small visits, one cup to share.

Year Round Christmas ShopLast ChristmasOne more Christmas in London.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCovent Garden cevapi rolls with ajvarGrilled beef and lamb sausages in soft rolls with ajvar and sour creamHow to make it300g beef mince200g lamb mince2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp sweet paprika1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda1 tsp salt4 soft rolls1 jar ajvar100g sour cream1 onion, finely diced1 small bunch parsleyMix the minces with the garlic, paprika, bicarb and salt and knead briefly.Roll into short fingers and chill.Grill over high heat, turning, until charred.Split and toast the rolls and spread with ajvar.Add cevapi to each and top with sour cream, onion and parsley.Petra's cheese burekCoiled filo pie of feta and cottage cheese, the way Kate's mum makes itHow to make it375g filo pastry250g feta, crumbled250g cottage cheese2 eggs100g butter, melted150g Greek yoghurtHeat the oven to 190°C and butter a 25cm round tin.Mix the feta, cottage cheese and eggs.Brush two filo sheets with butter, lay one on the other, spoon a line of filling along one long edge and roll into a log.Coil the logs into the tin from the middle out and brush the top with butter.Bake 35 to 40 minutes until deep golden. Rest 10 minutes and serve in wedges with yoghurt.MainsPetra's stuffed capsicums with yoghurtCapsicums stuffed with beef and rice, baked in tomato, garlic yoghurtHow to make it1 onion, diced3 garlic cloves (2 for the filling, 1 for the yoghurt)500g beef mince100g long grain rice2 tsp sweet paprika1 tsp smoked paprika4 large red capsicums700g passata200g Greek yoghurt1 loaf crusty breadFry the onion and two of the garlic cloves, add the mince and brown.Stir in the rice, both paprikas, salt and a little water and cook briefly.Cut the tops off the capsicums, remove the seeds and fill.Stand in a dish, pour around the passata mixed with water and bake covered at 180°C.Mix the yoghurt with the remaining crushed garlic. Serve with crusty bread.Tom's shelter Christmas turkeyChristmas dinner at the shelter where Tom volunteers, and Kate finally pitches inHow to make it1.5kg turkey breast roast80g butter, softened1 sage1 lemon1.2kg roasting potatoes3 tbsp olive oil400g Brussels sprouts2 tbsp plain flour400ml chicken stockHeat the oven to 190°C. Mash the butter with chopped sage, lemon zest and salt and push it under the turkey skin.Roast the turkey for 1 hour 20 minutes, with the parboiled potatoes tossed in 2 tbsp of the oil in a second tray.Rest the turkey for 20 minutes. Halve the sprouts and roast them in the rest of the oil for 15 minutes.Stir the flour into the roasting pan juices on the stove, whisk in the stock and simmer for 4 minutes for gravy.Carve and serve with the potatoes, sprouts and gravy.SweetsYear-round Christmas shop gingerbreadSpiced gingerbread with golden syrup, cinnamon and orangeHow to make it100g butter100g golden syrup80g brown sugar300g self-raising flour2 tsp ground ginger1 tsp ground cinnamon1 orange, zested1 egg150g icing sugar1 lemon, juicedMelt the butter with the golden syrup and sugar. Mix in the flour, spices, orange zest and egg.Chill the dough.Roll out and cut stars and snowflakes.Bake at 180°C, then cool.Mix the icing sugar with lemon juice and pipe on snowflake patterns.Santa's shop mince pies with orange creamShortcrust mince pies served with orange creamHow to make it3 sheets of shortcrust pastry1 jar fruit mince (400g)1 egg, beaten200ml thickened cream2 tbsp icing sugar1 orange, zested and juicedCut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.Fill each with fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.Brush with egg and bake at 190°C until golden.Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar, the orange zest and a tablespoon of the orange juice.Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the orange cream.DrinksCovent Garden mulled grape juiceRed grape and apple juice simmered with orange, cinnamon, star anise and cloveHow to make it500ml red grape juice300ml cloudy apple juice2 black tea bags250ml boiling water200ml orange juice1 tbsp brown sugar4 cinnamon sticks12 cloves4 star anises2 orangesSteep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, then remove.Pour the grape juice, apple juice and tea into a saucepan with the orange juice, sugar, cinnamon, cloves, star anise and one sliced orange.Warm gently, keeping it under a simmer.Ladle into heatproof glasses with a wheel cut from the second orange.
